# Tcl Command Reference Manual (`informal shell`)

Complete reference for all commands available in `informal shell`, generated directly from `crates/informal-fpv/src/compat/help.rs`.

> **Interactive help:** Inside `informal shell`, run `help`, `help -apps`, `help -all`, or `help <command>` to view this exact documentation.

## Flavors

- **`common`**: Available in every flavor (`::informal::<cmd>`, `::jg::<cmd>`, `::vcf::<cmd>`).
- **`jg`**: JasperGold-style flavor (`informal shell --flavor jg`, auto-detected by default).
- **`vcf`**: VC Formal-style flavor (`informal shell --flavor vcf`, auto-detected when `read_file`/`create_clock`/`fvassert`/`check_fv` appear).

## Design Setup (Analyze, Elaborate, Clocks, Reset, Blackbox)

### `clear` (`jg`)

Reset the current session, clearing design files, elaboration, and properties

```tcl
clear [-all]
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-all` | Clear all design state, tasks, and properties |

**Cross-flavor equivalent:** VCF: start a new session

```tcl
clear -all
```

### `analyze` (`jg`)

Collect SystemVerilog source files, filelists, defines, and include paths

```tcl
analyze [-sv|-sv09|-sv12|-sv17|-v2k|-verilog] [-clear] [-bbox_m {M ...}] [-f list] [+define+K=V] [+incdir+D] file ...
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-sv / -sv12 / -sv17 ...` | Language standard flags (accepted; parsed as IEEE 1800-2023 SystemVerilog) |
| `-bbox_m <mods>` | Mark module name(s) as source-less black boxes |
| `-clear` | Clear previously analyzed files and black boxes |
| `-f / -F <filelist>` | Read compile arguments and files from a VCS/Jasper filelist (`$VAR` expanded) |
| `+define+K[=V] / -define / -D` | Define preprocessor macro(s) |
| `+incdir+D / -incdir` | Add `include` search directory |

**Accepted & ignored vendor options:** `-lib`, `-L`

**Cross-flavor equivalent:** VCF: `analyze -format sverilog` or `read_file`

**Notes:** VHDL (`-vhdl*`) is rejected with a clear error.

```tcl
analyze -sv12 +incdir+rtl +define+FORMAL rtl/counter.sv
```

### `elaborate` (`jg`)

Elaborate the analyzed SystemVerilog design with `svlang`

```tcl
elaborate [-top M] [-parameter P V] [-bbox_m {M ...}] [-bbox_i {inst ...}] [-bbox_mul W] [-bbox_a N] [-disable_auto_bbox] [-no_preconditions] [-create_related_covers {precondition witness}]
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-top <module>` | Top module name (inferred if omitted and unambiguous) |
| `-parameter / -param <P> <V>` | Override top-level parameter `P` with value `V` (repeatable) |
| `-bbox_m <mods>` | Black-box module definition(s) (outputs become free inputs) |
| `-bbox_i <insts>` | Black-box specific instance hierarchy path(s) |
| `-bbox_mul <bits>` | Auto-blackbox multipliers at or above `<bits>` width |
| `-bbox_a <words>` | Auto-blackbox unpacked arrays/memories at or above `<words>` depth |
| `-disable_auto_bbox` | Disable automatic complexity black-boxing |
| `-no_preconditions` | Skip automatic precondition vacuity covers |
| `-create_related_covers <kinds>` | Enable `precondition` and/or `witness` covers |

**Accepted & ignored vendor options:** `-loop_limit`, `-multiple_tops`, `-extract_covergroup`, `-x_value`, `-auto_hr_info`

**Cross-flavor equivalent:** VCF: `elaborate <top>` / `read_file -top <top>`

**Notes:** Extracts all RTL concurrent and immediate assertions, assumptions, and covers into `<embedded>`.

```tcl
elaborate -top fifo -parameter DEPTH 8 -create_related_covers {precondition witness}
```

### `clock` (`jg`)

Declare primary or derived design clocks (or forward Tcl's built-in `clock`)

```tcl
clock <sig> [-factor N] [-phase P] [-both_edges] | clock -clear | clock -none | clock -infer
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-factor <N>` | Clock period multiplier relative to the primary clock |
| `-phase <P>` | Clock phase offset |
| `-both_edges` | Accepted for compatibility (both edges handled by netlist) |
| `-clear` | Clear declared clocks |
| `-none` | Mark design as combinational (no clock) |
| `-infer` | Auto-infer clocks from elaborated sequential elements |

**Cross-flavor equivalent:** VCF: `create_clock`

**Notes:** Tcl's standard `clock seconds` / `clock format` subcommands are automatically forwarded to `::informal::tcl_clock`.

```tcl
clock clk
```

### `reset` (`jg`)

Declare the formal reset condition held in cycle 0 and released thereafter

```tcl
reset -expression {<expr>} | reset <expr> | reset -none | reset -analyze_only
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-expression / -expr <expr>` | Active-high reset predicate (e.g., `{!rst_n}` for active-low reset) |
| `-none` | Run without an explicit reset constraint |
| `-analyze_only` | Report reset structure without changing the session reset |
| `-non_resettable_regs` | List registers without reset drivers |

**Cross-flavor equivalent:** VCF: `create_reset`

**Notes:** Expression identifiers are checked against the elaborated top module.

```tcl
reset -expression {!rst_n}
```

### `set_blackbox` (`vcf`)

```tcl

```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-designs <mods>` | Black-box module definitions |
| `-cells <paths>` | Black-box specific instance paths |
| `-clear` | Clear existing black boxes |

**Cross-flavor equivalent:** JG: `elaborate -bbox_m / -bbox_i`



## Properties, Cut Points, and Tasks

### `assert` (`jg`)

Add, enable, disable, or remove SVA assertions in a task

```tcl
assert [-name N] [-task T] [-bound K] [-env] {<sva_expr>} | assert (-disable|-enable|-remove) [-task T] [-regexp] <pattern ...>
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-name <N>` | Property name (auto-generated if omitted) |
| `-task <T>` | Target task (default current task) |
| `-bound <K>` | Cap proof depth at `K` cycles (reports `bounded_proven` if unviolated) |
| `-env` | Treat this property as an environment `assume` instead of an assertion |
| `-disable / -enable / -remove` | Toggle or delete matching properties (glob or `-regexp`) |
| `-regexp` | Interpret selection pattern as a regular expression |

**Accepted & ignored vendor options:** `-severity`, `-tag`, `-from_property`

**Cross-flavor equivalent:** VCF: `fvassert`, `fvdisable`, `fvenable`

**Notes:** Identifiers are validated against top-module declarations immediately; unsupported SVA operators report cleanly on `prove`.

```tcl
assert -name a_max {q <= 4'd9}
assert -disable {a_debug_*}
```

### `assume` (`jg`)

Add environment assumptions, promote helper assertions, or toggle/remove assumptions

```tcl
assume [-name N] [-task T] {<sva_expr>} | assume -from_assert <pat> [-name N] [-task T] [-regexp] | assume (-disable|-enable|-remove) [-task T] [-regexp] <pattern ...>
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-name <N>` | Assumption name |
| `-task <T>` | Target task (default current task) |
| `-from_assert <pat>` | Promote helper assertion(s) into assumptions with provenance tracking |
| `-disable / -enable / -remove` | Toggle or delete matching assumptions (including RTL assumes per task) |
| `-regexp` | Interpret pattern as a regular expression |

**Accepted & ignored vendor options:** `-severity`, `-tag`, `-from_property`

**Cross-flavor equivalent:** VCF: `fvassume`

**Notes:** `-from_assert` never circularly assumes assertion P while proving P itself.

```tcl
assume -name m_no_ovf {!(full && push)}
assume -from_assert a_helper_inv
```

### `cover` (`jg`)

Add, enable, disable, or remove SVA reachability cover properties

```tcl
cover [-name N] [-task T] [-bound K] {<sva_expr>} | cover (-disable|-enable|-remove) [-task T] [-regexp] <pattern ...>
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-name <N>` | Cover property name |
| `-task <T>` | Target task (default current task) |
| `-bound <K>` | Cap search depth at `K` cycles |
| `-disable / -enable / -remove` | Toggle or delete matching covers |
| `-regexp` | Interpret selection pattern as a regular expression |

**Accepted & ignored vendor options:** `-severity`, `-tag`, `-from_property`

**Cross-flavor equivalent:** VCF: `fvcover`

**Notes:** A witness trace proves reachability (`covered`); an unbounded safety proof means `unreachable`.

```tcl
cover -name c_full {full ##1 pop}
```

### `stopat` (`jg`)

Cut signals from their RTL drivers so they become unconstrained free inputs in a task

```tcl
stopat [-task T] <sig ...> | stopat -clear [-task T] [sig ...] | stopat -list [-task T]
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-task <T>` | Apply cut points to task `T` (default current task) |
| `-clear` | Remove listed cut points, or all cut points in the task |
| `-list` | Return active cut points as a Tcl list |

**Accepted & ignored vendor options:** `-env`

**Cross-flavor equivalent:** VCF: `snip_driver`

**Notes:** Cut points are task-scoped: cutting a signal in task `T` leaves it driven in `<embedded>` and other tasks.

```tcl
stopat -task FreeFsm u_alu.mul_res
```

### `task` (`jg`)

Create, edit, switch, list, or delete isolated formal verification tasks

```tcl
task [-create T|-edit T|-set T|-delete T|-list] [-source_task S] [-copy {pat}] [-copy_asserts] [-copy_assumes] [-copy_covers] [-copy_stopats] [-copy_all] [-regexp]
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-create <T>` | Create task `T` (optionally with `-set` and copy flags) |
| `-edit <T>` | Copy additional properties or cut points into existing task `T` |
| `-set <T>` | Make `T` the current active task |
| `-delete <T>` | Delete task `T` (cannot delete `<embedded>`) |
| `-list` | Return Tcl list of task names (`<embedded>` first) |
| `-source_task <S>` | Copy source task (default current task) |
| `-copy <pats>` | Copy properties matching glob(s) or `-regexp` |
| `-copy_asserts / -copy_assumes / -copy_covers` | Copy all properties of the specified kind |
| `-copy_stopats / -copy_all` | Copy cut points, or copy all properties and cut points |

**Accepted & ignored vendor options:** `-copy_ratings`, `-copy_abstractions`, `-copy_related_covers`, `-copy_proof_settings`

**Cross-flavor equivalent:** JG: `get_task_list`

**Notes:** Call `task` with no arguments to return the current task name. Each task is lowered and proved independently.

```tcl
task -create FastPath -copy {a_fast_*} -copy_assumes -set
```

## Proving, Engines, and Reporting

### `set_engines` (`common`)

Restrict the proof portfolio to named engines

```tcl
set_engines [engine_name ...]
```

**Cross-flavor equivalent:** JG: `set_engine_mode`

**Notes:** Pass an empty list to re-enable all configured engines. Unknown engine names are rejected with the available list.

```tcl
set_engines informal-bmc informal-kind informal-ic3
```

### `prove` (`jg`)

Run the engine portfolio on properties or tasks and print a verdict table

```tcl
prove [-all] [-task T] [-property {P ...}] [-time_limit D] [-bound K] [-with_proof_core]
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-all` | Prove all enabled properties in the current task |
| `-task <T>` | Prove all enabled properties in task `T` |
| `-property <list>` | Prove only the named property or properties |
| `-time_limit / -per_property_time_limit <D>` | Override per-property timeout (e.g. `30s`, `5m`, `1h`) |
| `-bound <K>` | Bound BMC/safety proofs to `K` cycles (`bounded_proven`) |
| `-with_proof_core` | Extract minimal needed assumptions and state support for proven assertions |
| `-engine_mode <modes>` | Temporarily map Jasper engine letters (`Ht`, `Hp`, `B`, `N`) |

**Accepted & ignored vendor options:** `-bg`, `-dump_trace`, `-orchestration`, `-sst`

**Cross-flavor equivalent:** VCF: `check_fv`

**Notes:** Runs environment consistency check first (when vacuity is on) and precondition/witness covers after proven assertions.

```tcl
prove -all
prove -task Safety -time_limit 60s -with_proof_core
```

### `get_property_list` (`jg`)

Query property names filtered by type, status, task, name, or disabled flag

```tcl
get_property_list [-task T] [-include {k v ...}] [-exclude {k v ...}] [-regexp]
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-task <T>` | Restrict to properties in task `T` |
| `-include <pairs>` | Key/value filter pairs (`type`, `status`, `name`, `disabled`, `task`) |
| `-exclude <pairs>` | Key/value exclusion pairs |
| `-regexp` | Treat `name` filter values as regular expressions |

**Cross-flavor equivalent:** VCF: `get_props`

**Notes:** Returns a Tcl list of matching property names.

```tcl
get_property_list -include {type assert status cex}
```

### `get_status` (`jg`)

Return the verification status string of a single property

```tcl
get_status <property_name>
```

**Notes:** Returns one of `proven`, `bounded_proven`, `cex`, `covered`, `unreachable`, `undetermined`, `error`, or `unprocessed`.

```tcl
set st [get_status a_max]
```

### `set_engine_mode` (`jg`)

Map JasperGold engine mode letters (`Ht`, `Hp`, `B`, `N`, ...) to InFormal engines

```tcl
set_engine_mode {<mode> ...}
```


### `report` (`jg`)

Print or export property tables, CSV summaries, design info, or per-property details

```tcl

```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-task <T>` | Restrict report to task `T` |
| `-summary / -results` | Print property verdict table (default) |
| `-detail` | Print detailed per-property engine, depth, vacuity, and memory metrics |
| `-design` | Print design structure and lowered model sizes (`get_design_info`) |
| `-property <P>` | Limit `-detail` output to one property |
| `-csv` | Format table as CSV |
| `-file <F>` | Write output to file (`-force` overwrites existing file) |

**Cross-flavor equivalent:** VCF: `report_fv`

```tcl
report -csv -file results.csv -force
```

## Debugging, Complexity, and Abstraction

### `why_cex` (`common`)

Compute a dynamic backward causal root-cause slice of a CEX or cover trace

```tcl
why_cex [-property P] [-max_events N] [-json] [property_name]
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-property <P>` | Failing assertion or covered witness property name |
| `-max_events <N>` | Limit reported causal events |
| `-json` | Emit structured JSON causal slice |

**Cross-flavor equivalent:** JasperGold Visualize QuietTrace / VC Formal RCA

**Notes:** Walks backward from failure cycle T to 0, pruning untaken mux arms and non-controlling logic operands.

```tcl
why_cex -property a_never9
```

### `get_fv_complexity` (`common`)

Analyze cone-of-influence state bits, memories, and wide-arithmetic proof hotspots

```tcl
get_fv_complexity [-property P] [-task T] [-json]
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-property <P>` | Restrict complexity analysis to one property's COI |
| `-task <T>` | Target task (default current task) |
| `-json` | Return structured JSON breakdown |

**Cross-flavor equivalent:** JasperGold Proof Profiling / Complexity Analyzer

**Notes:** Highlights wide counters, multipliers, and unpacked arrays that stall bit-level IC3/k-induction.

```tcl
get_fv_complexity -property a_fifo_order
```

### `blackbox_assistant` (`common`)

Recommend or apply complexity-driven black-boxing of heavy submodules


| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-threshold_bits <N>` | Minimum flop/memory bit threshold to flag a candidate |
| `-apply` | Automatically add recommended modules to the blackbox list |
| `-json` | Return recommendations as JSON |

**Cross-flavor equivalent:** JasperGold Complexity Manager

**Notes:** Run before `prove` or when `get_fv_complexity` flags deep arithmetic/storage blocks.

```tcl
blackbox_assistant -threshold_bits 128
```

## Formal Apps

### `check_conn` (`common`)

Formal Connectivity App: verify pin-to-pin / muxed / pipelined CSV connectivity maps

```tcl
check_conn (-load <csv> | -prove | -report | -list | -clear | -init | -validate) [options]
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-load <csv>` | Load OpenTitan/JasperGold CONNECTION/CONDITION/LATENCY CSV into task |
| `-prove` | Prove all loaded connectivity assertions |
| `-report` | Print connectivity verification summary (use `-file F [-force]` to save) |
| `-list` | List loaded connectivity rules |
| `-task <T>` | Target task name (default `Connectivity`) |
| `-time_limit <dur>` | Per-property time limit |
| `-clear` | Clear loaded connectivity rules |
| `-init` | Initialize connectivity app state |
| `-file <F>` | Write report to file (with `-force` to overwrite) |

**Accepted & ignored vendor options:** `-bg`, `-silent`, `-generate_candidates`, `-validate`

**Cross-flavor equivalent:** JasperGold Connectivity App (`check_conn`)

**Notes:** Supports `CONNECTION,name,src,dst`, `CONDITION,name,cond`, and `LATENCY,name,cycles` CSV directives.

```tcl
check_conn -load conn.csv
check_conn -prove
check_conn -report
```

### `check_cov` (`common`)

Formal Coverage & UNR App: COI observability, branch/toggle dead-code detection, and waivers

```tcl
check_cov (-init | -measure | -report | -waiver | -clear) [options]
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-init` | Initialize coverage models (`-model {coi branch toggle functional}`) |
| `-model <list>` | Coverage models to track: `coi`, `branch`, `toggle`, `functional` |
| `-measure` | Run formal reachability/COI measurement on active cover items |
| `-report` | Print coverage summary (`-html -report_file F -force` for HTML report) |
| `-waiver` | Manage waivers (`-add\|-remove\|-list`, `-type`, `-instance`, `-comment`, `-cid`) |
| `-task <T> / -tasks <L>` | Restrict measurement or reporting to specific task(s) |
| `-time_limit <dur>` | Time limit per UNR check |
| `-clear` | Reset coverage state |

**Accepted & ignored vendor options:** `-bg`, `-silent`, `-no_return`, `-view`, `-exclude_bind_hierarchies`, `-enable_prove_based_proof_core`

**Cross-flavor equivalent:** JasperGold Coverage App (`check_cov`)

**Notes:** Proves unreachable branches/toggles (UNR) and reports Cone-of-Influence observability.

```tcl
check_cov -init -model {coi branch toggle}
check_cov -measure
check_cov -report
```

### `check_xprop` (`common`)

Exact 2-copy self-composition Formal X-Propagation App

| `-prove` | Prove all generated X-propagation checks |

### `check_spv` (`common`)

Formal Security Path Verification (SPV) App: 2-safety non-interference and taint flow


| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-create` | Define a taint/isolation check (`-name N -from S -to O [-cond C]`) |
| `-name <N>` | Property name for the security path check |
| `-from <sig>` | Sensitive source signal (e.g., key register or port) |
| `-to <sig>` | Observable sink signal (e.g., public or debug output) |
| `-cond / -precond <expr>` | Optional guard condition under which isolation must hold |
| `-prove` | Prove all defined SPV checks |
| `-report` | Print SPV results (`-file F [-force]`) |
| `-list` | List defined SPV checks |
| `-task <T>` | Target task name (default `SPV`) |
| `-time_limit <dur>` | Per-property time limit |
| `-clear` | Clear SPV checks |

**Accepted & ignored vendor options:** `-bg`, `-silent`

**Cross-flavor equivalent:** JasperGold SPV App (`check_spv`)

**Notes:** Detects both direct combinational and multi-cycle covert storage leaks via 2-copy miter.

```tcl
check_spv -create -name iso_key -from secret_key -to debug_o -cond {!dbg_en}
check_spv -prove
check_spv -report
```

### `check_sec` (`common`)

Formal Sequential (SEC) and Combinational (LEC) Equivalence Checking App

```tcl
check_sec (-setup | -map | -prove | -report | -list | -clear) [options]
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-setup` | Configure spec vs. implementation designs (`-spec`, `-imp`, `-clock`, `-reset`) |
| `-spec / -spec_files <F>` | Reference specification RTL file(s) (`-spec_top`, `-spec_param`, `-spec_define`, `-spec_incdir`) |
| `-imp / -imp_files <F>` | Implementation RTL file(s) (`-imp_top`, `-imp_param`, `-imp_define`, `-imp_incdir`) |
| `-lec` | Run combinational keypoint equivalence mode (match state/outputs directly) |
| `-latency <N>` | Retiming pipeline latency offset (`imp` delayed by N cycles relative to `spec`) |
| `-clock <clk> / -reset <expr>` | Clock and reset expression for sequential equivalence |
| `-map` | Explicitly map `-input`, `-output`, `-state`, or `-output_latency` pairs, or add `-assume` |
| `-prove` | Prove equivalence across all mapped outputs |
| `-report` | Print SEC/LEC report (`-json`, `-file F [-force]`) |
| `-task <T>` | Target task name (default `SEC`) |
| `-time_limit <dur>` | Per-output time limit |
| `-clear` | Clear SEC setup |

**Accepted & ignored vendor options:** `-auto`

**Cross-flavor equivalent:** JasperGold SEC App (`check_sec`)

**Notes:** Generates side-by-side `spec`/`imp` mismatch VCD traces on non-equivalence.

```tcl
check_sec -setup -spec spec.sv -imp imp.sv -clock clk -reset {!rst_n} -prove
check_sec -report
```

Formal CSR / RAL Verification App from OpenTitan HJSON, CSV, or UVM RAL `.sv`

1-command Formal Bus Protocol VIP Generator (`tlul`, `axi4lite`, `apb`)

## Environment, Vacuity, Lowering, and Proof Cache

### `set_lowering` (`common`)

Toggle opt-in SystemVerilog lowering relaxations

```tcl
set_lowering [skip_initial_checks|isunknown_is_false [on|off]]
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `skip_initial_checks` | Omit time-0 checks in `initial` blocks instead of rejecting them |
| `isunknown_is_false` | Lower `$isunknown(x)` as constant `0` (2-state) instead of rejecting it |

**Cross-flavor equivalent:** CLI: `informal lower --skip-initial-checks --isunknown-is-false`

**Notes:** Both switches default to `off` (decision D13: never guess silently). Changing a switch invalidates elaboration so the next `elaborate` or `prove` re-lowers.

```tcl
set_lowering isunknown_is_false on
```

### `check_assumptions` (`common`)

Check assumption satisfiability, UNSAT conflict cores, and 2QBF dead-end trap states

```tcl
check_assumptions [-depth N] [-conflict] [-dead_end]
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-depth N` | Unrolling depth for environment consistency check (default 20) |
| `-conflict` | Compute a minimal conflicting subset of assumptions when overconstrained |
| `-dead_end` | Run 2QBF trap-state check detecting reachable states with no legal next input |

**Notes:** With `-dead_end`, returns `alive` or `dead_end at step ...`; with `-conflict`, returns a list of conflicting assumptions; otherwise returns the allowed trace depth. Automatically run before `prove` when vacuity checking is on.

```tcl
check_assumptions -depth 20 -conflict -dead_end
```

### `set_vacuity` (`common`)

Enable or disable automatic environment and precondition vacuity checks

```tcl
set_vacuity [on|off]
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `on` | Enable environment consistency (depth 20) and precondition vacuity covers |
| `off` | Disable automatic vacuity checks during `prove` |

**Cross-flavor equivalent:** JG: `elaborate -no_preconditions`

**Notes:** On by default. Call with no arguments to query current state.

```tcl
set_vacuity on
```

### `set_prove_cache` (`common`)

Enable or disable the content-addressed SHA-256 proof cache

```tcl
set_prove_cache [on|off]
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `on` | Enable caching of proven and unreachable verdicts |
| `off` | Disable proof cache lookup and writes |

**Notes:** Keys are computed from the exact lowered Btor2 model (design + active assumptions + cut points + property).

```tcl
set_prove_cache on
```

### `set_prove_cache_path` (`common`)

Get or set the proof cache directory path

```tcl
set_prove_cache_path [dir]
```

**Notes:** Share across CI runs to skip re-proving unchanged properties.

```tcl
set_prove_cache_path .informal_cache
```

### `set_prove_cache_mode` (`common`)

Set proof cache read/write policy

```tcl
set_prove_cache_mode [read_write|read_only|write_only]
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `read_write` | Read hits and store new proofs (default) |
| `read_only` | Reuse cached verdicts without writing new entries |
| `write_only` | Always re-prove and refresh cache entries |

```tcl
set_prove_cache_mode read_write
```

## Shell Utilities

### `help` (`common`)

Show Tcl command reference, options, and examples

```tcl
help [command|pattern] [-all|-jg|-vcf|-common|-apps|-verbose|-json]
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-all` | List commands across common, JasperGold (jg), and VC Formal (vcf) flavors |
| `-jg` | List JasperGold-flavor and common commands |
| `-vcf` | List VC Formal-flavor and common commands |
| `-common` | List flavor-independent InFormal commands only |
| `-apps` | List Formal Apps (`check_*`) only |
| `-verbose` | Show full detail for a command (accepted for vendor compatibility) |
| `-json` | Emit the full command catalog as JSON |

**Cross-flavor equivalent:** Available in both `jg` and `vcf` flavors

**Notes:** Use `jg::<cmd>` or `vcf::<cmd>` to disambiguate commands that exist in both flavors (such as `analyze` or `elaborate`).

```tcl
help
help prove
help -apps
help *cache*
```

### `get_version` (`common`)

Return the InFormal version string

```tcl
get_version
```

```tcl
puts [get_version]
```

### `echo` (`common`)

Print arguments separated by spaces to standard output

```tcl
echo [word ...]
```

**Notes:** Suppressed in `informal shell --check` dry-run mode.

```tcl
echo Starting FPV run
```

### `session` (`common`)

Dump the complete FPV session state as pretty-printed JSON

```tcl
session
```

**Notes:** Useful for debugging scripts or driving external tooling.

```tcl
set js [informal::session]
```

### `include` (`jg`)

Source another Tcl file in the global scope (JasperGold alias for `source`)

```tcl
include <file.tcl>
```

**Cross-flavor equivalent:** Standard Tcl: `source`

**Notes:** Followed recursively by `informal shell --check`.

```tcl
include common_env.tcl
```
